Load Brazilian vaccination data from the SI-PNI system via DATASUS

Source: R/vaccines.R
load_vaccines.Rd

Retrieves vaccination records from Brazil's official National Immunization Program Information System (SI-PNI), made available through DATASUS. This function supports automated retrieval across all supported years: for historical data (1994-2023), it queries the legacy SI-PNI Web portal via HTTP; from 2024 onwards, it queries the new DATASUS interactive dashboard (infoms.saude.gov.br) directly. Alternatively, the user may provide a locally downloaded file via data, in which case the function performs only validation, cleaning, harmonization, and standardization.

Usage

load_vaccines(
  year,
  state,
  strategy = NULL,
  product = NULL,
  dose = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  language = "eng"
)

Arguments

year

A numeric value indicating the year of the data to be downloaded (1994 to present).

state

A string indicating the Brazilian state abbreviation (e.g., "SP", "RJ", "AC").

strategy

A string identifying the vaccination strategy (e.g., "Rotina", "Especial", "Bloqueio"). If NULL and in an interactive session, a menu will appear.

product

A string identifying the specific vaccine product (e.g., "BCG - BCG", "Hepatite B - HB"). For 2024 onwards, both legacy names (e.g., "BCG - BCG") and new dashboard names (e.g., "87 - vacina covid-19-RNAm, Pfizer (Comirnaty)") are accepted. If NULL and in an interactive session, a menu will appear.

dose

A character vector indicating the dose categories that were selected when downloading the data. This argument is only required when using manually downloaded files up to 2022.

data

An optional path to a local Excel (.xls/.xlsx) file downloaded manually from the official DATASUS vaccination dashboard. If provided, automated retrieval is skipped and the function performs only data cleaning and harmonization.

language

A string indicating the desired language for variable names and labels. Accepts "eng" (default) or "pt".

Value

A tibble (data frame) containing state, year, municipality codes, municipality names, strategy, product, month, dose type, and the quantity of doses applied.

Details

Regardless of the ingestion mode, the returned dataset is fully harmonized and consistent across years (1994 to present).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# Example: Loading Yellow Fever vaccine data for Acre in 2020
data <- load_vaccines(
  year = 2020,
  state = "AC",
  strategy = "Rotina",
  product = "Febre amarela - FA",
  language = "eng"
)
}
